content_sections.heading: MHRB M&HO-I Vacancy 2026 – Post Details
content_sections.text: A total of 560 posts of Medical & Health Officer-I are being filled, inclusive of backlog vacancies. The category-wise breakup, including women's reservation within each category, is given below. In addition, 22 posts (4% of total) are horizontally reserved for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD), and 11 posts are reserved for Ex-servicemen, both within the overall 560 vacancies. The notification states that the actual number of posts, including the reservation breakup, may vary as per requirement in due course, and any change will be intimated before the date of interview/examination.

rows.pwbd_category: Locomotor Disability / Orthopedically Handicapped (at least one arm and both legs)

content_sections.heading: MHRB M&HO-I Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: The candidate must have Indian citizenship as defined under Articles 5 to 8 of the Constitution of India. Government doctors already serving under the Directorate of Medical Education (DME), Directorate of Health Services (DHS), National Health Mission (NHM), Assam, or other Government of Assam agencies are eligible to apply, and no separate No Objection Certificate (NOC) is required from them to apply. Candidates already employed in Corporations/Boards or in private employment may apply with intimation to their present employer, and must produce an NOC from their employer at the time of document verification/interview.

content_sections.heading: MHRB M&HO-I Qualification
content_sections.text: The candidate must hold an MBBS degree from any university recognised by the Medical Council of India (MCI). The candidate must be registered under the Assam Medical Council.

content_sections.heading: MHRB M&HO-I Age Limit
content_sections.text: As on 01.01.2026, a candidate should not be less than 21 years and not more than 38 years of age, as per Government Notification AAP.115/72/Pt.I/194 dated 10.03.2008. The upper age limit is relaxable for candidates of reserved categories as per existing provisions/extant rules; specific relaxation figures by category are not specified in the notification. Candidates are advised to check whether they satisfy the prescribed age limit before applying. Use our online Age Calculator to calculate your exact age instantly.

content_sections.heading: MHRB M&HO-I Salary
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will draw pay in the scale of Rs. 30,000 – Rs. 1,10,000 plus Grade Pay of Rs. 12,700 , along with other allowances admissible under the Rules of the Government of Assam. Government servants joining service on or after 1st February 2005 will be governed by the New Pension Scheme 2005 rather than the Assam Service (Pension) Rules, 1969.

content_sections.heading: MHRB M&HO-I Application Fee
content_sections.text: The fee can be deposited through a Treasury Challan under the Head of Account "0210-Medical and Public Health-01-Urban Health Services-800-Other Receipt," or paid online through the Government Receipt Accounting System (GRAS) at https://assamegras.gov.in. A printed copy of the Treasury Challan generated through GRAS must be submitted at the time of interview, with the applied post mentioned in the Remarks column. The fee is non-refundable, and no other mode of fee payment is accepted.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for MHRB Assam M&HO-I Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the official website: https://nhm.assam.gov.in Navigate to Recruitment → National Health Mission, Assam New. Log in using your mobile number and password. Fill up the online application form for the M&HO-I post. Upload the required photograph and signature; applications without these are liable to be summarily rejected. Submit the form – no further changes will be applicable once submitted. Deposit the application fee via Treasury Challan or GRAS, as applicable, and retain the receipt. Candidates need not submit testimonials or certificates at the time of online application. However, original testimonials regarding educational qualification, date of birth, caste, PWD status, treasury challan, and work experience must be produced at the time of interview, along with self-attested copies for submission to the Board.

faq.question: Q1. What is MHRB Assam M&HO-I Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment drive by the Medical and Health Recruitment Board, Assam, to fill 560 posts of Medical & Health Officer-I under the Health & Family Welfare Department, Government of Assam.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in MHRB M&HO-I Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 560 vacancies in total, including backlog vacancies, distributed across Open, OBC/MOBC, SC, ST(P), and ST(H) categories, with additional horizontal reservation for PwBD and Ex-servicemen candidates.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification required for MHRB M&HO-I posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold an MBBS degree from a university recognised by the Medical Council of India (MCI) and be registered under the Assam Medical Council.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for MHRB M&HO-I Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must be between 21 and 38 years of age as on 01.01.2026, with upper age relaxation available for reserved category candidates as per existing rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the last date to apply for MHRB M&HO-I Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for receipt of online applications is 20 September 2026. The website will be open for applicants from 7 September 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for MHRB M&HO-I Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Rs. 250 for General category candidates, Rs. 150 for OBC/MOBC/SC/ST(P)/ST(H) candidates, and no fee for PWD candidates.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary for the MHRB M&HO-I post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will draw pay in the scale of Rs. 30,000 – Rs. 1,10,000 plus Grade Pay of Rs. 12,700, along with other admissible allowances.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply for MHRB Assam M&HO-I Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online through https://nhm.assam.gov.in under Recruitment → National Health Mission, Assam New, using a mobile number and password to log in.
